description: Search California building codes (Title 24), state housing law and California city and county zoning/municipal codes by TOPIC, when the user does not already have a section number — e.g. "minimum attic access opening", "ADU setbacks in San Jose". Requires the user's GoCodebook account and uses 1 credit per search (also when nothing is found). If the user already cites a section number, use lookup_california_code_section instead — it is free. Returns ranked excerpts with citations and links. It does NOT decide whether a project complies.

code_edition.description: Optional. Which Title 24 cycle to search; a permit filed in 2024 is enforced under "2022". Defaults to "current".

jurisdiction.description: Optional. A California city or county slug ("san-jose", "marin-county") to search that place's own code together with the state codes. Omit for statewide.

query.description: What to find, in plain words. Up to 300 characters.

sources.description: Optional. Limit to federal law, state codes, or local ordinances.

name: search_california_codes
